```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Many Americans once worked 40 hours a week for 40 years for a single employer who provided pay to support a family, health insurance, and a pension.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Today, Americans change jobs more frequently than ever and compete against workers around the world for pay and benefits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Today, in the majority of families, all parents work.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Millions of working Americans are members of a new \"sandwich generation,\" playing dual roles as working parents and working children, responsible for their kids and their aging mothers and fathers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Members of the \"sandwich generation\" are working longer hours than ever while meeting a new and growing set of caregiving responsibilities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Government policies, many designed in the New Deal era, have not kept up with the new economy and the changing nature of people's lives.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe it is time for policies and expectations to catch up with the new economy and the changing nature of people's lives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support modernizing policies from health care to pensions, from unemployment insurance to paid leave to provide working Americans the tools they need to meet new realities and challenges.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
